title: Restore strict unknown-flag rejection for say (t-d481 behaviour reverted on main by a634690)
desc: Regression: commit a634690 (14:42) fixed the inbox DM clause but reverted the t-481 say fix merged as 96c797c — main() now folds unknown argv back into say's text (main():2118-2121) and the parser help text is gone. Evidence on current main: tests/test_say_unknown_flags.py exits 1 (case1 'unknown flag accepted silently (rc=0)', posts text='hello --typee note'). ACCEPTANCE: (1) restore the two hunks as in 96c797c: parser help 'to start the text with a dash, put -- before it' + the strict gate die with the '--' hint for say (non-say subcommands keep their current die); (2) tests/test_say_unknown_flags.py red on main -> green on branch, output pasted; (3) '--' escape hatch and normal say intact (test cases 2/3); (4) no other subcommand arg handling touched, no format changes (R10). NOTE: this is a re-land; the known-good source is 96c797c:bin/chatcode.

history.note: PR #20 merged (0f438e5, merged_by dreamer2664). Verified on main: bin/chatcode carries the restored gate, tests/test_say_unknown_flags.py exits 0 (3 cases) where it was red before. t-d481 behaviour is back on main.
